states.name: S0
states.meaning: No nonempty suffix since reset matches a prefix of 1101; start_shifting=0. Before any reset=1 row, the initial state is S0 and start_shifting=0 for examples that begin without reset. When reset=0, next state is S1 if data=1, else S0. When reset=1, state becomes S0.
states.update_time: posedge clk after reset and data are sampled; visible after the edge settles

states.name: S1
states.meaning: Longest matched suffix is 1; start_shifting=0. When reset=0, next state is S11 if data=1, else S0. When reset=1, state becomes S0.
states.update_time: posedge clk after reset and data are sampled; visible after the edge settles

states.name: S11
states.meaning: Longest matched suffix is 11; start_shifting=0. When reset=0, next state is S11 if data=1 (overlapping 1s), else S110. When reset=1, state becomes S0.
states.update_time: posedge clk after reset and data are sampled; visible after the edge settles

states.name: S110
states.meaning: Longest matched suffix is 110; start_shifting=0. When reset=0, next state is FOUND if data=1, else S0. When reset=1, state becomes S0.
states.update_time: posedge clk after reset and data are sampled; visible after the edge settles

states.name: FOUND
states.meaning: Sequence 1101 has been detected; start_shifting=1 sticky. When reset=0, remains FOUND for either data value. When reset=1, state becomes S0.
states.update_time: posedge clk after reset and data are sampled; visible after the edge settles

rules.condition: reset==1 at the sampled posedge; synchronous reset forces FSM state S0 and start_shifting=0 on the settled edge
reset==0 and (state==FOUND or (state==S110 and data==1)); after the settled posedge start_shifting=1 and remains 1 in FOUND until reset
rules.spec_quote: set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset

rules.condition: reset==0 and not (state==FOUND or (state==S110 and data==1)); after the settled posedge start_shifting=0
rules.spec_quote: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: The first sampled posedge row with reset==0 after one or more reset==1 sampled rows is the first released cycle; the FSM starts from S0 and that row's data may begin a new search.

mid: Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.

uncertain.note: The public specification explicitly states start_shifting becomes 1 when 1101 is found and remains 1 until reset, but does not explicitly state the pre-detection value; the contract assumes start_shifting=0 before detection.
candidates: start_shifting is 0 before detection and only becomes 1 when 1101 is found
start_shifting may be undefined before the first 1101 detection, but reset values set it to 0
start_shifting is initially 1 and remains 1 before the first reset, instead of being forced 0 before detection

uncertain.note: The public specification states reset is active high synchronous, but does not explicitly state the reset target state or the reset value of start_shifting; the contract assumes reset clears the FSM to S0 and start_shifting=0.
candidates: synchronous active-high reset forces state S0 and start_shifting=0 on the reset posedge
synchronous active-high reset clears start_shifting to 0 but the state encoding after reset is unspecified
synchronous active-high reset clears start_shifting to 0 but leaves the search state unchanged, so a preserved FOUND state reasserts start_shifting after reset is released

uncertain.note: The public specification states start_shifting is set to 1 when 1101 is found but does not specify whether the output updates on the detection posedge (same_cycle) or one clock later (next_cycle); the contract currently chooses same_cycle.
candidates: same_cycle: start_shifting becomes 1 on the posedge that completes 1101
next_cycle: start_shifting remains 0 on the posedge that completes 1101 and becomes 1 on the following posedge
